['Select target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_description', 'From activities', 'Join assays ON activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary ON assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Join molecule_dictionary ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_records ON activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id', 'Join docs ON compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id', "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Saccharomyces cerevisiae'", "Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'", 'Select distinct target_description', 'Sort by target_description', 'Return target_description']
